summary: In 2025, Australia reported a GDP of 1,798,518,933,689.21 USD and GDP per capita of 65,129.7228 USD, with inflation of 2.874%. As of 2026-09-11, the AUD/USD exchange rate was 0.717257 USD per 1 AUD, up 0.232%, while the 10-year bond yield was unavailable. From 2016 to 2025, GDP grew from 1,211,588,128,417.61 USD to the 2025 figure, inflation peaked at 6.5941% in 2022 before falling to 2.874% in 2025, and the annual AUD/USD rate ranged from 0.729281 in 2020 to 0.645012 in 2025, reaching 0.703428 in 2026.
